title: Community Values
summary: The shared principles that guide daily conduct.
body: Hospitality, courage, patience, and respect for elders sit at the core of Murle community values. These principles are reinforced through storytelling, proverbs, and the example set by respected community members.
Collective responsibility is highly valued — decisions affecting the community are often discussed openly, and individual actions are understood to reflect on family and clan alike.
These values continue to guide community life today, adapting to new circumstances while remaining rooted in generations of shared practice.
